sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase date windows: the year page's note on a setlist ("Incomplete setlist.", "Setlist may be incorrect or out of order.") was read as part of the last song, and "No set details known." as a one-song setlist (951 songs across the year pages). The note is now a line of its own under the songs, and an entry with only that note shows no song. Year pages read before are read once more.
